## Fixes for Schedule I 0.4.7f6

- Custom phone contacts now show the correct sender information on the first save load, including when the native contact lookup cannot find a sender yet. Fixes [#320](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/320) through [PR #322](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/322).
- `GameLifecycle.OnLoadComplete` listeners registered before entering the main scene are retained across a return to the menu and do not fire twice on the next load. Fixes [#321](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/321) through [PR #323](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/323).
- Texts sent by custom phone contacts during `OnLoadComplete` survive the delayed NPC network spawn and are written to `NPCs.json` on an ordinary save. Fixes [#324](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/324) through [PR #325](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/325).

## Compatibility and validation

- No public S1API signatures, save identifiers, or network payloads changed.
- The contact and lifecycle fixes were reproduced and checked in the game on Mono and IL2CPP. For the conversation fix, three contacts retained their messages through spawn and save in both runtimes; a fresh IL2CPP load retained the saved history through another spawn and save.
- The `3.2.1-beta.6` source builds without warnings or errors, with 724 Mono and 710 IL2CPP contract tests passing.
- This is a GitHub-only prerelease for the game beta. It does not publish to NuGet, Nexus Mods, or Thunderstore.

## Known issue

- [#319](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/319), a reported `VOEmitter` rejection on a second load, remains under investigation. It has not reproduced with the available local fixture and is not claimed as fixed here.
